comparison: Frozen native XGBoost versus financial rule classes and the existing frontend Monte Carlo predictor. Monte Carlo retains ORIGINAL shock assumptions; it is not informed of the outcome regime.
software_acceptance: All hashes unchanged; reconciliation tolerance 0.011 LKR; fixed threshold 0.5; safe invalid/unsupported handling; add/remove identity; monotonic positive expense effects for supported predictions. Zero model fitting.
performance_acceptance: Report-only. No minimum accuracy used to tune, select, relabel, retry or promote models. Distribution-shift deterioration is a finding, not permission to change the model.
origin: All numerical stress ranges, templates and quotas are hypothetical engineering-test choices, not Sri Lankan market statistics or observed event outcomes.
ancestry: 12 designed root families, each with 15 budget/receipt planning states. All share existing cost/source templates. Replicated outcomes and grid cases are not independent observed events.
output_policy: Reports only: case inputs/provenance and aggregate counts/metrics. No master/training dataset, individual outcome table, retraining or frontend change.
holdout_disclosure: New predeclared targeted stress evaluation after model freeze; not a randomly sampled population test, unseen-venue evaluation or independent real-world validation. Existing v3 holdout was previously inspected.
